projects.title: Personal Flask Website
projects.overview: Built a personal portfolio website using Flask, HTML, and CSS with separate Home, Contact, and Projects pages. The application was later refactored to use Flask Blueprints and a JSON-driven project portfolio.
projects.learning: I learned how Flask routes, templates, static assets, and Blueprints work together to create a maintainable web application.

projects.title: Graduate Admissions Web Scraping and Data Cleaning
projects.overview: Collected graduate admissions information and transformed raw website data into structured applicant records. The project introduced parsing, normalization, data cleaning, and reproducible dataset generation.
projects.learning: I learned that reliable data extraction and normalization are as important as the analysis that follows.

projects.title: PostgreSQL Analytics and Flask Integration
projects.overview: Extended the admissions project by loading records into PostgreSQL, querying the database, and displaying analytical results through a Flask application. The project connected data collection, persistence, querying, and presentation.
projects.learning: I learned how application logic, SQL queries, database persistence, and Flask can work as one end-to-end system.

projects.title: Testing, Coverage, and Documentation
projects.overview: Added automated testing, database-focused test scenarios, code coverage, and Sphinx documentation to the admissions application. The project emphasized software quality and reproducibility.
projects.learning: I learned how tests, coverage, configuration, and documentation make software more trustworthy and maintainable.

projects.title: Packaging, Dependency Analysis, and Database Hardening
projects.overview: Improved the project environment through dependency management, packaging, database security, and deployment-oriented documentation. The module focused on creating a more reproducible and professionally structured Python project.
projects.learning: I learned that reproducibility, least privilege, and dependency management are core parts of software engineering rather than administrative tasks.

projects.title: Containerized Services and Background Processing
projects.overview: Expanded the admissions system into a containerized multi-service architecture with background tasks, messaging, and analytics. The project introduced Docker-based services and asynchronous processing.
projects.learning: I learned how distributed application components communicate and why service health, task state, and startup behavior matter.

projects.title: AWS S3, Notebook, and EC2 Deployment
projects.overview: Moved parts of the project workflow into AWS using S3, a hosted notebook environment, and EC2 deployment. The module focused on cloud storage, credential handling, reusable AWS access, and deployment.
projects.learning: I learned how local Python applications can be extended into cloud workflows while keeping security and reproducibility in mind.

projects.title: Data Cleaning, Statistical Analysis, and Visualization
projects.overview: Performed deeper cleaning, feature engineering, statistical testing, outlier analysis, and visualization of the graduate admissions dataset. The project transformed raw records into analysis-ready information.
projects.learning: I learned how data-quality decisions directly affect statistical conclusions and visual interpretation.

projects.title: K-Means Clustering
projects.overview: Applied TF-IDF, dimensionality reduction, and K-Means clustering to identify patterns across graduate programs and universities. The project included cluster selection, interpretation, and visualization.
projects.learning: I learned how unsupervised learning can reveal structure in data even when no target label is available.

projects.title: Exploratory Data Analysis and Interactive Visualization
projects.overview: Created static and interactive visualizations to explore admissions trends and communicate analytical findings. The project combined exploratory questions with dashboard-style presentation.
projects.learning: I learned how visualization design affects whether analytical results are understandable and actionable.

projects.title: K-Means MLOps Pipeline
projects.overview: Extended the clustering work into a more reproducible machine-learning pipeline with supporting documentation, execution evidence, and model information. The module introduced practical MLOps concepts.
projects.learning: I learned how a machine-learning experiment becomes more useful when its execution, dependencies, artifacts, and outputs are reproducible.

projects.title: Neural Network from Scratch with NumPy
projects.overview: Implemented a two-layer neural network manually using NumPy to classify graduate admissions outcomes. The project covered preprocessing, forward propagation, sigmoid activation, loss calculation, backpropagation, and evaluation.
projects.learning: I learned much more about neural-network mechanics by implementing the forward and backward passes directly instead of relying on a machine-learning framework.

projects.title: Fine-Tuned DistilBERT Admissions Classifier
projects.overview: Fine-tuned a pretrained DistilBERT transformer for admissions classification, evaluated it on held-out data, saved and reloaded the model, and deployed predictions through Flask. The final model achieved 73.93% held-out accuracy.
projects.learning: I learned how pretrained language models can be adapted and deployed, while also seeing that greater model complexity does not automatically create a proportionally better solution.
